description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted  Partners for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to you for sale No. 10 Dún na Mara, a beautifully presented, owner-occupied, three-bedroom family residence with converted garage, large south-facing  garden, and additional rear annex.

This wonderful home has been lovingly maintained and handsomely upgraded by its current owners, with evidence of their attention to detail apparent throughout.

On arrival, you are greeted by a fully extended driveway providing ample off-street parking for several vehicles, complemented by decorative fencing, curved kerbing, and mature shrubbery.

Upon entering, you are welcomed into a most inviting, spacious and light-filled entrance hallway, finished with attractive artisan tiling.

To the left is the first of the living spaces, featuring an original fireplace, painted wooden flooring and an abundance of natural light, creating a warm and comfortable space.

To the rear of the property is the outstanding dining room, which is flooded with natural light from the large patio windows overlooking the garden. This generous space provides ample room for dining and storage and leads seamlessly into the kitchen area, which comes complete with modern wall tiling and ample built-in storage.

The property’s original garage has been completely converted and now provides an additional dining area and office space, finished in striking artisan tiling. This area leads into a most convenient scullery, featuring matching floor tiling and excellent additional storage.

Upstairs, you are greeted by a large and light-filled landing, complete with a gable window.

To the rear of the property is the impressive master bedroom, featuring original wooden flooring, ample built-in storage and pleasant views towards the garden. There is also a further generous double bedroom, benefiting from an abundance of natural light and ample floor space for a desk or study area. A further single bedroom is located to the front of the property.

The family bathroom has been fully upgraded and now features an oversized curved shower in place of the original bath. The bathroom is finished with attractive floor-to-ceiling tiling, modern fixtures and fittings, a heated towel rail and additional built-in storage.

The rear garden is a particularly attractive feature of this wonderful home. There is a large patio area, ideal for alfresco dining and entertaining, leading onto a manicured lawn with decorative pebble borders. To the rear is an additional outbuilding, which would make an ideal workshop or hobby space and could also be potentially transformed into habitable accommodation.

If you are looking for an owner-occupied, wonderfully located and beautifully presented three-bedroom family residence, with excellent additional downstairs space, a generous south-facing rear garden situated within one of Galway’s most cherished neighbourhoods, we suggest you look no further than No. 10 Dún na Mara.

This is a home that offers space, versatility, excellent presentation and genuine family appeal.

Call us today to arrange your viewing visit. We will  be delighted to assist you in any way we can.

Brought to you by Fairdeal Property, your trusted partners for residential property sales.
